definitions.explanation: The capacity to perceive and respond to emotional, aesthetic, or sensory stimuli. A person's innate ability to feel things deeply and be moved by beauty, art, nature, or the emotions of others.

examples.japanese: {感受性|かんじゅせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧だ。

⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{感受性|かんじゅせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Children have strong sensitivity, so they are easily influenced by their surroundings.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧ことで、⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な{感受性|かんじゅせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{育|はぐく}まれる→育む：10390_hagukumu⟧。
examples.english: Being exposed to many forms of art at a young age cultivates a rich sensibility.

notes:
USAGE:
{感受性|かんじゅせい} refers to an innate emotional and aesthetic sensitivity. It is considered a positive quality, especially in artistic and educational contexts. People with ⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な{感受性|かんじゅせい} (rich sensibility) are seen as emotionally perceptive and deeply responsive to beauty.
